g.text: Mail inbound to team reply — SMTP accept, sealed enqueue, grant-authorized run, sealed reply
MAIL FROM / RCPT TO crew@agents.example / DATA
claimable(limit, now); lease(qid, worker, ttl 15 min)
consult the run ledger before acting)
[sender holds a live mail grant for this team]
notice reply -- a third failure class:
Run under the grant (exactly one run per fingerprint)
seal reply for the sender's mailbox;
enqueue -- closed federation: enqueue IS delivery
Revoked mid-run: the reveal answers a bare 403; the bridge
sends an "output withheld; reveal with your wallet at
Run: <url>" notice and marks the original delivered. The
run still completes for its owner -- revocation cuts
